test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is a constant subtraction of 4.

**For QR to MN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bae8f976da8738b60a248995d2effcdd118202ff049ae8975fb780aabd1cedc0.png] 

**For NO to JK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1c2a11740575990dedcceb3328e953dab5c6632083e5f0616e538e8469b67a.png] 

 

For HJ to DL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/176728d1fae81e2d3c3250075ae9e98832a3d9838f5d4327fea6c78840c97bf9.png] 

 

**For LM to HI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/436960b62465218501e2b34eb468a58a9aff7bc8aae68e438bb3f59fe5070515.png] 

 

In this pair, the shifts are -4 and +2. This does not follow the group logic.

Thus, the pair **HJ - DL** is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
